# WeCare Landscapes

> Family-owned landscape design-build company in Hot Springs, Arkansas, operating since 1998. Specializes in custom hand-carved concrete artistry (not a common offering in the region), luxury outdoor living, hardscape and patios, water features, drainage correction, irrigation, sod sales/delivery/installation from its own sod farm, and ongoing lawn & property maintenance. Serves Hot Springs, Hot Springs Village, Benton, Bryant, Little Rock, Conway, and Russellville, Arkansas.

Phone: (501) 627-4384 · Email: derrick@wecarelandscapes.expert

## Core Services

- [Landscape Design & Build](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/landscape-design-build.html): Full-property design-build, outdoor living spaces.
- [Custom Carved Concrete Artistry](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/carved-concrete-artistry.html): Hand-carved concrete (faux rock, faux wood, custom sculptural pieces) — the company's signature differentiator.
- [Hardscape, Stonework & Patios](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/hardscape-stonework-patios.html): Flagstone patios, retaining walls, walkways.
- [Sod Sales, Delivery & Installation](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/sod.html): Sod grown on the company's own farm near Plainview, AR.
- [Free Zoysia Installation Offer](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/free-zoysia-sod.html): Free zoysia sod with professional installation (3-pallet minimum).
- [Drainage & Erosion Correction](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/drainage-erosion-correction.html): Dry creek beds, French drains, grading.
- [Irrigation Installation & Repair](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/irrigation-installation-repair.html)
- [Lawn & Property Maintenance](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/lawn-property-maintenance.html): Recurring mowing and property care (Hot Springs / Hot Springs Village focus).
- [Commercial Grounds Care](https://wecarelandscapes.expert/commercial-grounds-care.html): Hotels, HOAs, office/retail properties.
